description: This Java source file contains a JPA attribute converter class 'AccountingRuleTypeConverter' for converting between the 'AccountingRuleType' enum and its database representation (Integer). It is used within the Fineract loan account domain to facilitate persisting enum values as integers in the database.

classes.name: AccountingRuleTypeConverter
classes.description: A JPA attribute converter that converts 'AccountingRuleType' enum instances to Integer for database storage and vice versa.

methods.name: convertToDatabaseColumn
methods.description: Converts 'AccountingRuleType' enum to its integer database representation.

methods.name: convertToEntityAttribute
methods.description: Converts integer database value back to 'AccountingRuleType' enum.
